fee_notes: Minimum Initial Franchise Fee $45,000 for territory of 150,000-200,000 population. Additional territory charged at $230 per 1,000 population (maximum territory generally 300,000 but larger allowed in certain circumstances). Multiple discounts available (Roll-In, Multi-Unit, Additional Concept, HIRE, VetFran, Rural Franchise). 2025 historical: average $27,790, range $37,235-$58,214 after discounts. Separate Software System enrollment fee $1,250 applies.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchisee fee you must pay to us is $45,000 (the "Minimum Initial Franchise Fee") for a population of 150,000 - 200,000, plus $230 per each additional 1,000 population in your territory.
